global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth, topped with tender chashu, crisp menma, and a dark nori sheet. Served in a patterned bowl with a white spoon, it rests on a dark tray against a warm wooden backdrop, softly lit.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with smooth, reflective finish and subtle grain patterns visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric pattern and blue "とちん" text on its rim.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles appears creamy yellow, speckled with green onions, and holds soft, curved noodles beneath a dark seaweed sheet.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly tapered, rounded tip.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slightly curled edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show pale pinkish-white meat with tender texture, slightly curled edges, and faint green herb specks on surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft, fibrous texture and irregular, curled shape.
